name: RuView
description: π RuView turns commodity WiFi signals into real-time spatial intelligence, vital sign monitoring, and presence detection — all without a single pixel of video.
one_liner: Turns ordinary WiFi routers into a motion-and-breathing sensor that can tell if someone's in a room, moving, or struggling, without any cameras or wearables.
buyer: A smart-home installer or elder-care service that wants to offer fall and vitals monitoring for elderly clients without installing cameras in their home.
business_use_cases: A home-security installer offers a camera-free 'fall and vitals monitoring' add-on for elderly clients, using a few cheap WiFi sensor nodes instead of cameras or wearables.
A boutique smart-home integrator sells a 'sleep and breathing quality' package to health-conscious homeowners who already run Home Assistant.
A short-term rental host uses presence and occupancy detection to verify guest counts without installing cameras, which guests would otherwise object to.

money_ideas.idea: One-off hardware kit plus installation for a 'no-camera home monitoring' package
Ongoing monitoring and alerts subscription for elder-care families

steal_this: Package a 3-sensor ESP32 kit with a pre-configured RuView setup as a flat-fee 'fall detection for grandma' kit, skipping a subscription for the first version.
